description: US healthcare provider lookup (NPI) — Look up US doctors, clinicians and healthcare organizations in the CMS NPI registry: NPI number, name, credential, active status, primary specialty, practice address and phone. Search by NPI number, by last name (with optional first name, state, city, specialty), or by organization name. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
